title: The Empaneled Hour
description: Kim called in to ask how to get out of jury duty. The bailiff who picks up explains she was empaneled three weeks ago, the trial's concluded, and the jury can't be dismissed until the verdict is delivered. The catch: the verdict can't be delivered until the crime is committed, the crime is scheduled, and the calm, courteous bailiff keeps confirming Kim is the defendant, the foreperson, and the only witness, all at once.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Our next caller just wants to wriggle out of jury duty, and don't we all. Kim, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: Hey Ronnie. Yeah, so, I got summoned, and I really can't do it this month. <p:0.3> How do I get out of it? I never even got a letter.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's an easy one, Kim. You just call the courthouse and ask to be excused. That's progress.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: That's what I figured. So I called, and a guy picked up. Real polite. He's still on my other line.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: All rise. <p:0.3> Good evening. You've reached the court. How may the court assist you, juror Kim.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: See, I'm not a juror, I'm just trying to GET out of it. I never even got a letter.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: I have you here, ma'am. <p:0.3> You were empaneled three weeks ago. <p:0.3> The trial has already concluded. The court thanks you for your service.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Concluded? She just called. She hasn't done anything.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, hold on, that's wonderful. It's over, Kim. You're done. That's progress.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: Not quite, sir. <p:0.3> The jury cannot be dismissed until the verdict is delivered.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: Okay, fine, then deliver the verdict and let me go. I never even got a letter.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: The verdict cannot be delivered until the crime is committed, ma'am. <p:0.3> The crime is scheduled. <p:0.2> All rise.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [surprise-ah] Wait. The crime hasn't HAPPENED yet?

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: Ronnie, the floor just left. <p:0.3> Everybody in this courthouse just stood up at once and the FLOOR went with us.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: We're still deliberating. <p:0.3> Don't fight the rising, friend. The rising is the easy part.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Who's that now?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Chen. I'm on the jury too. <p:0.3> Been deliberating so long I forgot the charge. <p:0.3> But I voted already. We all voted.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: Voted on WHAT? I never even got a letter!

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: On you, ma'am. <p:0.3> You're the foreperson. <p:0.2> You're also the defendant. <p:0.2> And the only witness. The court thanks you.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: She can't be all three! That's not a TRIAL, that's a person in a room!

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: So I voted to convict MYSELF? Of a crime that hasn't HAPPENED? Orrin, I want out, I want out NOW.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: The defendant may not leave before the verdict, ma'am. <p:0.3> All rise.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: We're ALREADY up, Orrin! There's no more up! I'm at the CEILING!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Just hang up the phone, Kim. Hang up the OTHER line.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: There's no hanging up before the verdict, friend. <p:0.3> I tried. <p:0.3> The court just thanked me.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on, hold on, everybody. <p:0.3> Orrin. Orrin, just deliver the verdict so the woman can go home.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: Gladly, sir. <p:0.3> The crime has just been committed. <p:0.2> Right on schedule.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: I didn't DO anything!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: She didn't do anything!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: None of us did. We're still deliberating.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: I never even got a LETTER!

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: All rise.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: We ARE risen!

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: The court has reached a verdict. <p:0.3> Guilty. <p:0.2> The defendant is excused.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, Kim, sounds like you're finally getting out of jury duty.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: All rise. <p:0.3> The defendant is excused. <p:0.3> Permanently.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Permanently? Ronnie, what does he mean PERMANENTLY?

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: Mister Fitch. <p:0.3> You've been empaneled. <p:0.2> The whole studio is rising now.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, do NOT rise. Do NOT stand up. Sit DOWN, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now THAT'S service. <p:0.3> We'll be right back, folks. <p:0.3> Or, well. <p:0.3> We'll be UP.
